intro.text: A guard at a pub in Elendel. Blue may be his real name, or just what Wayne calls him.

items.text: Blue keeps order at the pub with a stick for clubbing rowdy customers. He knows Wayne from earlier visits and seems prepared, more or less, to put up with his antics.

appearance.text: Wears a cap and overalls as his guard's uniform.

personality.text: A plain, straightforward man while he is on duty.
